case_number: Civil Appeal No. 7934 of 2011; Civil Appeal Nos. 1258−1260 of 2019

parties.petitioner: M/s US Technologies International Pvt. Ltd.

summary: Late remittance of TDS vs non-deduction; Section 271C penalty applicability; strict construction of penal provisions; distinction between 'fails to deduct' (s.271C) and 'fails to pay' (s.276B); belated remittance attracts s.201(1A) interest, not s.271C penalty; reasonable cause under s.273B; ITAT finding of reasonable cause for delay upheld; High Court interference impermissible; precedent set by Kerala High Court Full Bench in Lakshadweep Development Corporation case.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court judgment setting aside ITAT order set aside; s.271C penalty not applicable for belated TDS remittance; penalty set aside; only s.201(1A)-leviable interest applicable.
